## What you're proposing

e.g. a new section in `SKILL.md`, a new reference doc, a new behavioral
test scenario, a change to risk-adaptive depth.

## Why

What failure mode or gap does this address? Concrete examples of agent
behavior you've seen (or expect) are more useful than abstract descriptions.

## Non-goals

Per the PRD, EDE is intentionally not a full SDLC methodology, TDD
replacement, or heavyweight process. If your proposal risks adding process
overhead disproportionate to task risk, say how you'd keep it lightweight
for trivial work.
